highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 improves consumer API documentation delivery and keeps the bundled renderer current with Chrome m154.
highlights_body: Package XML documentation now travels with managed assemblies, while generated bindings and HarfBuzzSharp metadata remain aligned with the bundled native sources.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz combining-class enum name corrected
breaking.body: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 has been renamed to CCC132 to match HarfBuzz. Replace the old member name in source code.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined removed
breaking.body: The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete flags your code needs instead.

bullets.detail: The pending release incorporates the latest upstream m154 renderer fixes.
Managed package assemblies now include compiler-generated XML documentation sidecars for IDE consumers.
